_meta.notes: doc_type=guide. HMAC-SHA256 기반 Authorization 헤더 생성 가이드. accessKey/secretKey/vendorId/signature 모두 MASKED. message 포맷, datetime 포맷(yyMMddTHHmmssZ, GMT+0), 언어별 구현 예시(Java/PHP/Python/C#) 포함.

code_snippets.php:
<?php
date_default_timezone_set("GMT+0");
$datetime = date("ymd").'T'.date("His").'Z';
$message = $datetime.$method.$path.$query;
$signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $message, $secretkey);
$authorization = "CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key=".$accesskey.", signed-date=".$datetime.", signature=".$signature;
code_snippets.python:
import os, time, hmac, hashlib
os.environ['TZ'] = 'GMT+0'
datetime = time.strftime('%y%m%d')+'T'+time.strftime('%H%M%S')+'Z'
message = datetime + method + path + query
signature = hmac.new(secretkey.encode('utf-8'), message.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
authorization = f"CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key={accesskey}, signed-date={datetime}, signature={signature}"
